# wso2is_governance_connector (Data Source)

Reads a governance connector with all of its properties, their current values and their descriptions. Use it to find property names for `wso2is_governance_connector`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_governance_connector" "password_recovery" {
  name = "account-recovery"
}

output "recovery_properties" {
  value = data.wso2is_governance_connector.password_recovery.properties
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connector name, for example `self-sign-up`.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Category name.
- `category_id` (String) Category ID.
- `friendly_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Connector ID.
- `properties` (Map of String) Current values by property name.
- `property_details` (Attributes List) Every property with its metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_details))

<a id="nestedatt--property_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `property_details`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `name` (String) Property name.
- `type` (String) Data type.
- `value` (String) Current value.
